source: Compiled from Flat Earth Society claims, Eric Dubay '200 Proofs', and academic literature on flat earth beliefs

theories.title: Earth is a Flat Disc
theories.claim: The Earth is a flat circular disc with the Arctic at the center and Antarctica as a 150-foot ice wall around the circumference
theories.testable_prediction: Traveling south from any point should eventually reach an ice wall rather than circling to the opposite hemisphere
evidence_for: Horizon appears flat at ground level
Water finds its level (appears flat in containers)
Bedford Level experiment (1838) showed flat water over 6 miles
evidence_against: Ships disappear hull-first over horizon (observed since antiquity)
Different stars visible at different latitudes
Circumnavigation achieved thousands of times by ships and aircraft
All satellite imagery shows a sphere
Lunar eclipses show Earth's circular shadow from every angle
GPS satellites orbit a sphere (4+ billion devices work correctly)
Time zones exist because Earth rotates
Southern hemisphere flight paths only work on a sphere (Santiago to Sydney)

theories.title: No Curvature Measurable
theories.claim: Earth's curvature of 8 inches per mile squared is never observed or measured in real-world conditions
theories.testable_prediction: A laser or telescope should be able to see objects at any distance over water with no drop-off
evidence_for: Some long-distance photographs appear to show objects that 'should' be hidden by curvature
Infrared cameras can image ships beyond theoretical visibility limit in some conditions
evidence_against: Atmospheric refraction (looming/superior mirage) explains all long-distance visibility anomalies
Surveying instruments routinely measure and correct for curvature
Bridges, tunnels, and railways are engineered with curvature corrections
The Bedford Level experiment was repeated by Alfred Wallace (1870) WITH curvature corrections and confirmed the globe

theories.title: NASA Fakes All Space Imagery
theories.claim: All photographs of Earth from space are computer-generated composites, and no genuine photograph of the whole Earth exists
theories.testable_prediction: Independent verification of Earth imagery from non-NASA sources would be impossible
evidence_for: NASA has acknowledged that some Blue Marble images are composites assembled from multiple passes
Cloud patterns in some NASA images appear duplicated (artifact of compositing process)
evidence_against: 60+ space agencies worldwide (ESA, JAXA, ISRO, CNSA, Roscosmos) independently produce Earth imagery
Private companies (SpaceX, Blue Origin) stream live video from orbit
Weather satellites operated by NOAA, EUMETSAT produce continuous real-time imagery
Amateur radio operators track and receive signals from satellites confirming orbital paths
The International Space Station is visible to the naked eye and trackable by amateur telescopes

theories.title: Gravity Does Not Exist
theories.claim: Gravity is not a force; objects fall because of density and buoyancy alone, and the flat earth accelerates upward at 9.8 m/s²
theories.testable_prediction: Objects of different densities in a vacuum should fall at different rates if buoyancy (not gravity) is the mechanism
evidence_for: In everyday experience, denser objects sink and lighter objects float
The mechanism of gravity is still debated in physics (quantum gravity unsolved)
evidence_against: Cavendish experiment (1798) measured gravitational attraction between lead spheres — no buoyancy involved
Apollo astronauts dropped hammer and feather in vacuum on Moon — fell at same rate
Satellites maintain orbit through gravitational mechanics — buoyancy cannot explain orbital motion
Tides correlate with Moon position (gravitational pull) not with density changes
Upward acceleration at 9.8 m/s² would exceed speed of light within one year

theories.title: Antarctica Treaty Hides the Ice Wall
theories.claim: The Antarctic Treaty System exists to prevent civilians from independently exploring Antarctica and discovering the ice wall edge of the flat earth
theories.testable_prediction: No civilian would be able to independently travel to or across Antarctica
evidence_for: The Antarctic Treaty restricts military activity and mineral exploitation
Few civilians have visited Antarctica compared to other continents
evidence_against: Thousands of tourists visit Antarctica annually (74,000+ in 2019-2020 season)
Multiple civilian expeditions have crossed Antarctica on foot (Borge Ousland 1997, solo crossing)
Research stations from 30+ countries operate there continuously with rotating staff
Commercial flights cross Antarctica (Qantas, LATAM operated polar routes)
The Treaty explicitly permits scientific research and tourism

theories.title: Sun is Local and Small
theories.claim: The sun is not 93 million miles away but approximately 3,000 miles above the flat earth disc, circling above like a spotlight
theories.testable_prediction: The sun's angular size should change measurably as it moves closer/further from the observer during the day
evidence_for: Sun appears to shrink toward the horizon at sunset (perspective argument)
Crepuscular rays appear to converge toward a nearby point
evidence_against: Sun's angular diameter is measured as constant (0.53°) throughout the day by anyone with a solar filter
Crepuscular rays are parallel — convergence is a perspective illusion (like railroad tracks)
Solar eclipses perfectly predicted by sphere+distance model for thousands of years
Stellar parallax measurements confirm solar distance independently
A 3,000-mile sun could not produce equal day/night on equinoxes at all longitudes simultaneously

theories.title: Stars Are Not Distant Suns
theories.claim: Stars are small luminaries embedded in a firmament dome above the flat earth, not distant suns trillions of miles away
theories.testable_prediction: Stellar parallax (apparent shift of nearby stars against distant background) should not exist
evidence_for: To the naked eye, stars appear as point lights that twinkle
Ancient cosmologies described stars as fixed lights on a sphere
evidence_against: Stellar parallax measured for thousands of stars (Hipparcos satellite, Gaia mission — billions of measurements)
Stars have measurably different spectra, temperatures, and luminosities
Binary star systems orbit each other with measurable periods
Galaxies resolved into individual stars by telescopes since 1920s
Neutrinos from stellar fusion detected on Earth (Homestake experiment, Super-Kamiokande)

theories.title: Flights in Southern Hemisphere Prove Flat Earth
theories.claim: Direct flights in the southern hemisphere take longer than expected because the distances are greater on a flat disc than on a sphere
theories.testable_prediction: Santiago to Sydney flight should take significantly longer than predicted by great circle route on a sphere
evidence_for: Some southern hemisphere routes have fewer direct connections
Flat earth map shows southern distances larger than on a globe
evidence_against: Santiago to Sydney: actual flight time ~12.5 hours, matching great circle prediction on sphere exactly
Johannesburg to Perth: ~11 hours, matches spherical prediction
Flight tracking (FlightRadar24) shows real-time paths matching spherical great circles
Airlines plan fuel loads using spherical distances — planes would crash if distances were wrong
Qantas operates non-stop Sydney-London (17 hours) — impossible on flat earth map geometry
